name: Real Pathfinder
description: Finds a route through any classic level using the game's real physics, then exports a verified macro.

restore-mode.name: Checkpoint Restore
restore-mode.description: Direct is faster. Practice-style resets the whole level before loading a checkpoint (like a practice respawn), which is more accurate on trigger-heavy levels. Try it if the pathfinder shows many repairs.

work-ms.name: Work Per Frame (ms)
work-ms.description: How long the search runs each frame. Higher = faster search, less responsive game.

checkpoint-interval.name: Checkpoint Interval (ticks)
checkpoint-interval.description: Physics ticks between saved states on a branch. Lower = faster search, more memory.

max-checkpoints.name: Max Checkpoints In Memory
max-checkpoints.description: Lower this if the game runs out of memory on huge levels.

max-branches.name: Max Branches
max-branches.description: The search gives up after trying this many branches.

repair-seconds.name: Repair Zone (seconds)
repair-seconds.description: If the clean replay dies, this much level time before the death is searched again in exact mode.
